notes.title: Version 0.02.09 - Significant performance boost
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I've been quiet for a while but haven't been sitting around. As some of you might know Nira is coming to Switch, which required some performance issues to be solved. To get the game running on Switch I've rewritten parts of the world generator to spread the loading of chunks much more evenly than before. This resulted not only in a huge performance boost, but also caused the overall game to run much more stable and smooth when moving around.

notes.title: Final Release is in sight!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I've been quiet for a while, but haven't been slacking! In the past months I've been working together with a new partner to improve the game and prepare for final release. More info about this partnership will be announcent next week, but for now I'd like to share a pre-final build of Nira. Outside of localization and proper testing, this will be the full release version of Nira. 

To access this new patch, you need to select the 'final' branch.
You can activate this branch by right clicking Nira from your library, selecting the Beta's tab and selecting the Final branch from there. The final version of Nira should then start downloading!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949318/1ed0e977e9297557c53bb0dae1d652fd04a20b68.png

The final version of the game includes an intro cutscene and adds more backstory to the game. It should make objectives more clear and give better guidance to new players, but it also has an ending! I hope this will make the entire experience more meaningful.

Additionally, I've add a set of new items, including sharks swimming around, Ogre's can do more attacks, a ton of new sound effects and much more! 

I'm really happy with this version of the game, but having added so much new stuff to the game, I really want it to get some proper testing before we go into full release. That's why I would like to ask everyone who's interested to try this version of the game, and let me know what you think of it.

Please stay tuned for next week's announcement, for which I'm really excited about. Until then, I hope you enjoy the latest patch and would love to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.02.02
notes.notes:
This update brings the game fully to GameMaker 2.3. This was quite a challenge as a ton of code broke in different places of the game all at once, and figuring out exactly where and why took a lot of time. Now that the full transfer is done I'm not planning on updating to any new engine versions soon, so this should improve update speed.

With this update, the Totem can not be broken anymore by hand. Instead you can now upgrade the totem you start with. This was done in prepartion for full release, where the Totem will play a bigger role. A Totem Destroyer item was added to make sure you can still destroy the Totem if you really want to move to another location.

Besides the Totem, a couple of cool new things where added such as birds, and snow, which I'm really happy with and I hope you guys will enjoy as well.

Lastly, a couple more of the last remaining big bugs have been fixed. The one I have been struggling with ever since starting Nira was the blood particles. It took me a long time to figure out how to make sure they didn't clip through the player, but I finally found a way. This also means the blood splatters on the ground will never despawn (until you walk away far enough for the chunk to unload), which means you can paint the world red!

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.02.01
notes.notes:
This patch contains a ton of bug fixes that were long overdue. The most important bug fix is one that caused boats or tamed animals to disappear over time. I've attempted to fix this bug for about 10 times before, but never managed to find the cause of the issue. This time I found it was directly related to the autosaving feature and decide to rewrite a big part of the saving feature. I've spent a full weekend testing the new saving system and did not encounter a single issue, so I hope it works as it should now! 

The other bugs that were fixed in this patched were caused by the engine upgrade. Moving to GameMaker Studio 2.3 was essential to maintain updates for the coming time, but sadly also caused quite some parts of the code to break. This patch should fix the majority of issues though!

If you find any issues with the current patch, please do report them! There's a button in the menu to report any bugs, and it really helps improve the game.

notes.title: Release Date announcement + New Trailer!
notes.notes:
February 20th, 2019 – Today, Baseline Games has revealed the release date for Nira to be April 24th, 2020. A new trailer was published showing a player gradually progress throughout the game. Starting with nothing, a player can explore an endless procedurally generated world looking for resources, which can then be used to craft items and build a base. Players are free to do what they want and can choose to spend their time doing a range of activities like farming, fishing, cooking, taming, riding animals and even flying a plane. But the world of Nira is not without its dangers… During the night, creatures arise, and players will have to carefully prepare by building defenses and weapons to survive.

Nira will release in Early Access on Steam. Through Early Access, Baseline Games hopes to get player feedback, and eventually determine the game’s future together with the community. 

[previewyoutube=wg2atLTNROA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171120/

• Website: http://baselinegames.com/
• Press kit: http://baselinegames.com/press-kit/
• Development Blog: http://baselinegames.com/blog/

About Nira
Nira is a fast-paced survival exploration game. Explore endless procedurally generated worlds to gather resources you need to survive. But when night falls, creatures arise. Build a base, craft weapons and tame wild animals to fight hordes of goblins. Explore, Build, Fight, Survive, and find Nira.

Features
• Explore endless procedurally generated worlds full of resources
• Build a base and craft weapons to defend yourself at night
• Fight off goblins and riddle their ogre leaders with bullets
• Survive nature: catch and cook food, and tame or hunt wild animals

About Baseline Games
Baseline Games is a one-man-studio founded in 2017, currently working on survival exploration game Nira. Nira is Baseline Games‘ first official game and is scheduled for an Early Access release on Steam on April 24th, 2020.For press inquiries, please reach out to info@baselinegames.com or reach out through social media:
Twitter – Instagram – YouTube – Facebook – Newsletter
